best_post_sharpe: Added valuation factor, enabled 3-seed ensemble with bagging_fraction=0.8, ran factor mining, added portfolio caps config, fixed data_random_seed ensemble bug
notes: All model-level changes degraded performance: valuation+ensemble Sharpe 0.65
column16: ensemble+tech Sharpe 0.74 vs baseline 1.48. Factor mining found 0 valid factors (compute failures). Ensemble has data_random_seed bug (now fixed).
column19: Valuation factors add noise (Alpha158 already captures value signals implicitly). Bootstrap bagging (0.8 fraction) weakens individual members. FactorMiner._compute silently fails for all 24 candidates. Portfolio caps added to base.yaml but untested. 10/15 fetcher cache domains still unfetched.

baseline_scope: Tested seed-only ensemble (no bagging, 3 members, full data per member). Same-model Sharpe 1.722 vs baseline 1.483, but WFV mean_sharpe 0.552 vs 0.668.
diagnostic_report: Seed ensemble improves same-model Sharpe (+0.239) but degrades WFV mean_sharpe (-0.116). Same-model improvement is misleading — ensemble smooths predictions on seen data without improving out-of-sample generalization. WFV already trains per-fold so ensemble marginal benefit is small.
column16: Key insight: same-model backtest improvements don't predict WFV improvements. Ensemble reduces in-sample variance but not out-of-sample error. The data_random_seed bug fix is valuable for future use but ensemble should stay disabled by default.

best_pre_sharpe: Fixed FactorMiner IC bug (index level mismatch), tested northbound/sector/margin factors, XGBoost model, LGBM hyperparameter tuning, backtest param grid search. All changes degraded WFV.
strategy_iteration_ids: FactorMiner fixed (9 factors found but weak IC/ICIR). Northbound factor: zero-fill noise. Sector factor: categorical dominance (Sharpe 0.30). XGBoost: worse than LGBM (0.999 vs 1.483). LGBM reg: both configs degraded. Grid search topk=20/n_drop=1: same-model +0.024 but WFV -0.199. Alpha158 captures all accessible alpha; param tuning only reweights overfit.
column17: Iteration #3 conclusion: the system has reached a ceiling with Alpha158+LGBM. All factor additions add noise (Alpha158 redundancy), all model changes degrade performance, all param changes overfit same-model. WFV mean_sharpe=0.668 is the ceiling. To break through, need genuinely new data sources (e.g., alternative data, news sentiment, supply-chain) that are orthogonal to price/volume features.
